title: Days Gone Bye (The Walking Dead)
search_title_used: the walking dead days gone by
premise_summary: "Days Gone Bye" is the pilot episode of the post-apocalyptic horror television series The Walking Dead. It originally aired on AMC in the United States on October 31, 2010. The episode's teleplay was written and directed by Frank Darabont, the series creator.
